description: Life Analytics IAS is the integrated analysis support system from Life Analytics for research teams. This ChatGPT app lets authorized users review IAS experiment records, analysis summaries, and report context from their workspace. It is read only, returns summarized research context only, and does not provide raw file export, personal data, diagnosis, treatment decisions, or clinical advice.
